notes.title: Summerland Version 1.0.9 Patch Notes + Optimization News
notes.content:
Hey everybody!  Late night update tonight.  Believe me when I say I'm on the verge of falling asleep typing this.  I was too excited to wait until the morning though, because I feel like I've done a lot to improve the overall experience of playing Summerland.

    - An addition save-point has been added to trial 1 upon entering the trial.
    - The blood in trial 1 has now become much more easily interactable.  This should make the level a bit easier overall.
    - Without spoiling, the thing you click at the end of chapter 4 is now much easier to figure out.
    - The headbob no longer runs when you're examining notes.
    - "Z" has been added as an alternative "focus" button.
    - There have been some subtitle edits throughout.

Also, please leave a comment here if you can point out anymore specific subtitle typos!  People keep pointing it out, but I can't seem to find anyone giving specific examples, so it's hard for me to find what needs fixed.  

I'd also like to thank you all so much because I've made enough money through donations that I can now afford to higher a freelancer to help optimize the game!  I've learned that my skill set isn't currently what it needs to be to make the necessary adjustments to get the game running smoothly, so bringing somebody else onboard will be the best way to get an optimization patch to all of you in a timely manner.

With all of that said and as always, please let me know if there's anything else I can do to improve your overall experience with Summerland.  I'm always working to make sure it's the best product I can offer.  Now, if you all don't mind, I'm going to go to my bed so that I don't pass out on the keyboard, haha.  Goodnight everyone!  I hope to talk to you all soon!

- Conner Rush

notes.title: Summerland Version 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everybody!  Hope you're all well!  I've been working hard on getting the game running a bit better, especially in trial 1.  Again, I'm not 100% sure the best ways to do this, but here's the gist of it...

    - Grass density has been decreased by about half in trial 1.
    - Many meshes have been combined to reduce draw calls.
    - Some minor adjustments have been made to make certain items easier to find.

I hope your all well!  Let me know if there's anything I can do to make the experience better!

notes.title: Summerland Version 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi, everybody!  Late night last night trying to fix some issues in the game.  Here's what's been done in the new 1.0.5 update.

    - Some more attempts have been made to optimize trial 1.
    - A new option is available in the settings page to invert the camera's vertical axis.
    - Some adjustments have been made throughout to make certain tasks easier.

I hope this addresses a lot of your concerns with the game.  I will continue working on and improving the experience, so please let me know if there's anything I can do.  Updates may temporarily slow as final exams are coming up.  Hooray for studying!  Thank you all for the support, and thank you all for just being here.

- Conner Rush

notes.title: Summerland Version 1.0.4 Patch Notes + Message from Dev
notes.content:
I've been working all day on a few small things to make the game an all around better experience.  Here are a few of those...

    - Some performance enhancements have been made throughout.
    - Mouse Sensitivity has been slight decreased across all mouse sensitivity presets by 1/4.
    - Some minor reworking to trial 1 to make some evidence easier to find.
    - Some models causing clipping issues have been fixed.  

While I'm always looking for things to fix and ways to improve the game, keep in mind that I'm just one guy, and I just got out of high school.  Working on this while in my first semester of college has been a big stress.  While I'm more than happy to address issues, just keep in mind the fact that this is a free passion project by a self-taught high schooler, haha.  All of that aside, I do really appreciate all of the support, and I hope t0 keep making you all proud in the future!  Take care!

- Conner Rush

EDIT: To clarify, the sensitivity adjustment was made ONLY to the mouse.  Gamepad joystick sensitivity has been unaltered.

notes.title: Summerland v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
It looks like v1.0.2 went over much better than v1.0.3!  Still, some very minor bugs fixes and improvements have been made.  Here's what's new...

    - Trial 1 has been very slightly reworked in an attempt to make evidence a bit easier to find.
    - A bug in trial 5 preventing the reminder from playing through completely has been patched.  I will also be combing the remaining trials for similar issues.
    - Fixed the arms being pink at the end of trial 8.
    - Fixed some things in trial 4 causing Matthew to clip onto furniture and tables.

The response to Summerland has been incredibly positive!  Thank you all so much for the phenomenal support!  Let me know if there's anything else I can do to improve your experience.

- Conner Rush of FYRE Games

notes.title: Summerland Version 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
I apologize for the previous v1.0.1 update.  It came with some issues that were entirely human error on my part.  I've fixed these and a few other things present in v1.0.2.

Here's what's been updated:
    - The bug preventing players from talking to Evelyn at the end of trial 1 has been patched out.
    - On the subject of trial 1, The level has been very slightly modified in the hopes of making some evidence easier to find.
    - The police report typo in trial 1 has been fixed.
    - Objects causing the player to clip onto the furniture in trials 2, 5, and 8 have been modified.
    - The barriers in trial 8 have been adjusted to prevent the player from falling through the map.

Let me know if there's anything I can do to further improve the experience for you!

notes.content:
Thank you for the support through the game's launch!  Here's a list of things that have been fixed in Summerland v1.0.1.

    - The bug where the ending conversation of trial 1 is repeated has been patched out.
    - Framerate drop when answering your phone in trial 3 has been patched.

There are a few things being addressed for a v1.0.2 update scheduled for tomorrow.  Let me know if there's anything you'd like to be looked at and I'll be sure to work on fixing it!
